description:
Search the Spark AI assets marketplace for agents, skills, prompts, prompt chains, MCP connectors and bundles.

For when a text query is available but the slug is not known; get_asset describes
a known slug. Returns numbered summaries with type, downloads, outcomes, price,
tags and URL, or a no-results message. No login required; no acquisition is made.
Unmatched nonempty queries may be recorded as unmet catalog needs. A nonempty
job ranks text matches by task fit, even with a non-combo sort.

For example, search_assets(query='rate limiting', job='add a rate limiter', limit=5).

domain.description: Optional domain slug from list_categories, e.g. 'development'; omitted means all domains.

job.description: Optional task, e.g. 'review Python code'; a nonempty value enables job-based ranking regardless of sort.

query.description: Text matched against titles and descriptions, e.g. 'rate limiting'; empty text browses the catalog.

sort.description: combo (default): quality, ratings and outcomes; popular: downloads; newest: creation date; rating: average rating. Invalid values fall back to combo; job enables ranking for any sort.

type.description: Optional asset type: agent, skill, prompt, prompt_chain, mcp_connector or bundle; omitted means all types.

name: search_assets
title: Search assets
